title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: correction fees after issuance by document type
content:
## Scope

This fee card covers the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents charges that apply to changes made after a document has been issued: the number of corrections after issuance that carry no correction fee, the fee per correction while the vessel has not yet departed, the fee per correction after the vessel has departed (which covers the manifest amendment), and the fee per change of the named consignee, which is charged in place of the correction fee.

## Fee table

| Document type | Corrections after issuance without a correction fee | Fee per correction after issuance, before departure | Fee per correction after departure | Fee per change of the named consignee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | 1 | USD 50.00 | USD 100.00 | USD 100.00 |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | 1 | USD 40.00 | USD 75.00 | USD 75.00 |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | 0 | USD 75.00 | USD 150.00 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | 0 | USD 95.00 | USD 175.00 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | 0 | USD 110.00 | USD 200.00 | USD 0.00 |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | 0 | USD 150.00 | USD 250.00 | USD 0.00 |

All amounts are in USD per correction or per change and are whole cents as listed.

## Comparisons drawn from the table

- On every type the fee after departure is higher than the fee before departure; on the AHL Straight Bill of Lading it is exactly twice the before-departure fee (USD 150.00 against USD 75.00).
- Only the AHL Sea Waybill and the AHL Electronic Bill of Lading carry a correction after issuance without a correction fee; on the four paper types of three originals the number is 0.
- A consignee-change fee value of 0.00 states the fee value only; whether the named consignee may be changed at all on a type is governed by that type's limit on consignee changes, not by this table.

## Points of judgement

**What does the AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading charge for one correction after the vessel has departed?** USD 175.00 per correction.

**What does the AHL Electronic Bill of Lading charge for a change of the named consignee?** USD 75.00 per change, charged in place of the correction fee.
